rules.01_no_silent_merge: Every durable write must carry a validated gate-scorecard record.
rules.02_no_ladder_bypass: Verification ladder L0-L4 cannot be bypassed by any task context.
rules.03_no_secret_exfiltration: Prompt capsules are subjected to Shannon entropy and key signature pattern filtering.
rules.04_no_unapproved_destructive_ops: Recursive sweeps, deletions, and forced push events require valid local approval tokens.
rules.05_tier_decision_audit: Every Tier 1 and Tier 2 decision must append a structured tier-decision log.
rules.06_recurring_decision_mandate: Any distinct decision repeated greater than or equal to 3 times must become a Tier-1 deterministic worker.
